title: Application of Fitcburg Gas and Electric Light Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, 94G, as amended , by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff , M.D.P.U. 199, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's costumers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of May , June, and July, 1993. The Fuel Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Department, of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power, pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department , and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
